items.name: Something Light
items.description: Crisp onion rings battered and fried until crunchy.

items.name: Soup of the Day
items.description: Our Soup of the Day is suitable for those following a vegetarian diet. Please ask your waiter what the Chef has prepared today. Served with a fresh bread roll and butter.

items.name: Tabbouleh
items.description: This refreshing Mediterranean dish is crisp, vibrant, nutritious and perfect as a light, healthy meal. Packed with parsley, bulgur wheat, chopped tomatoes and diced onion, it is brought to life by a bright, zesty lemon-olive oil dressing.

items.name: Greek Salad
items.description: A rustic dish featuring ripe tomato wedges, diced cucumber, sliced red onion, feta cheese and olives. Topped with garlic croutons and dressed with balsamic vinegar and olive oil.

categories.name: Pasta
categories.note: Please let the waiter know your choice of spaghetti, tagliatelle or penne.

items.name: Alfredo
items.description: A rich, creamy and smooth sauce of butter and grated Parmesan cheese, with a touch of garlic, fresh white pepper and nutmeg.

items.name: Mushroom and Green Peas
items.description: Mushroom and green peas simmered in a reduced smoked paprika and soy oat milk-coconut cream sauce, served topped with smoky coconut shavings.

items.name: Bolognese
items.description: Rich, slow-cooked sauce of beef, aromatic vegetables, red wine and a touch of tomato.

categories.name: Mains
categories.note: All main courses are served with your choice of thick-cut French fries, parsley mashed potato, pap, savoury samp, plain basmati or savoury rice, plus today’s fresh vegetable selection or a side salad.

items.name: The Best Bean Balls
items.description: Kidney beans, herbs and spices, oats and chickpea flour well blended and carefully cooked, and served with our homemade tomato sauce.

items.name: Grilled Chicken Leg Quarter
items.description: Basted with a Portuguese-style sauce and char-grilled.

items.name: Pork Ribs
items.description: These succulent, fall-off-the-bone pork ribs are grilled to smoky perfection and slathered in an irresistible, glossy and sticky barbecue glaze.

items.name: Lamb Curry
items.description: Slow-cooked in an aromatic sauce spiced with turmeric, cumin and coriander, ginger, garlic and tomato, finished with fresh coriander and served with a variety of sambals and a papadum.

categories.name: From the Grill
categories.note: Our expertly aged steaks are cooked precisely to your preference. Choose your favourite side sauce: mushroom, green peppercorn, cheese or Monkey Gland.

items.name: Fresh Fruit Salad and Ice Cream
items.description: A refreshing mix of seasonal fresh fruit topped with a velvety scoop of vanilla ice cream.

items.name: Banana Brownies
items.description: Incredibly delicious, completely plant-based, marbled with peanut butter and sprinkled with cinnamon.

items.name: Passionfruit Cheesecake
items.description: A refreshing balance of cream cheese and zesty, tart passionfruit set on a crushed gingernut base and spread with passionfruit jelly.
